description: Create a non-custodial payment draft (you are the SENDER paying a receiver address). Amount is either exact base units (sats for BTC, micro-units for stablecoins) via amountBaseUnits, or fiat-pegged via fiatCurrency+fiatAmount with the exchange rate locked at creation. Returns the draft incl. id, amounts, fee, and status. Funds move only when the sender signs in their own wallet. send21 never holds keys. Requires scope drafts:write.

amountBaseUnits.description: Exact amount in base units (sats / micro-units); omit when using fiat pricing

currency.description: Asset: Btc (default), Usdc, Usdt, or Eurc

fiatCurrency.description: Fiat currency code for fiat-pegged amount, e.g. USD

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key. Retries with the same key return the original draft

memo.description: Free-text memo shown on the draft (max 500 chars)

network.description: Network: Mainnet, Solana, Ethereum, Base (test: Testnet4, Signet, Regtest, SolanaDevnet, EthereumSepolia, BaseSepolia)

receiverAddress.description: Receiver address (Bitcoin bc1…, Solana base58, or 0x… for Ethereum/Base)

name: create_draft
